_help: UI strings of the proposal template. Add a language by copying this file to <lang>.json (e.g. de.json) and translating the values; missing keys fall back to English. _dir is ltr or rtl. _fonts_css is an optional extra stylesheet URL (e.g. Google Fonts for Arabic script) and _font_stack an optional font family (or comma-separated families) used for headings, text and labels; Persian (fa) and Arabic (ar) default to Vazirmatn from Google Fonts when neither is set. {name} placeholders are filled in by the template.
cost_title: Every missed visitor has a price.
new_mobile_note: Built for phones first, with the call button always in reach.

google_presence_note: 8 checks on how customers find you online today.
